changes.behavior: Only engineering push checks choose log_tail=True. Both streams are continuously drained; deque retains a diagnostic tail and actual total-byte counts. Output volume never kills the child or produces code125. Default JSON/payload byte caps, full lifetime deadline/cleanup, actual nonzero exit and protocol callers remain unchanged.

No prepared/generation/capsule representation ceilings. Exact data/SHA/path/no-clobber remain. Successful owner prepare is called exactly once. Any capture/event callback exception is recorded as observation incomplete with owner artifact/status, checkpoint stage and error type. If event I/O fails, event_saved=false remains in memory and stderr fallback; the original owner result is returned without a second call. Original owner failures still propagate unchanged.

No fixed receipt/report byte veto or row/text truncation of required evidence. Identity source checks and request/work bounds remain. Footprint retains full errors/skipped paths and complete report; RAW-DUP keeps all observed groups/locators/diagnostics and accepts obsolete detail-row option without enforcing it. Cross-market complete metadata preserves all jobs/reservations/documents while still excluding source bodies by field selection. JSON/nonfinite or real output I/O failures do not claim saved=true. Existing report schemas/compatibility entry names retained.

Worktree edits are diagnostic, not whole-tree permission. Git status is one optional call; failed status/branch observation stays unknown. Worker records actual loaded module relative paths/SHA/bytes after execution and rejects wrong runtime roots. Frozen sample/gold is not modified.

explicit_commit_pin.source: tools/holdout_replay/__main__.py:40 required --producer-commit; cmd_run:125 directly passes args.producer_commit; runner:107 verifies it before loading the manifest.
explicit_commit_pin.retained: Explicit requested HEAD must match actual producer HEAD.
explicit_commit_pin.baseline_independence: manifest.base_code_commit is not used as a runtime permission or compared with current HEAD. A new engine can replay the same frozen sample/gold with the new explicit producer argument; no gold rewrite or human signature is required. Worktree differences and post-execution source-file identities are recorded separately rather than described as immutable committed bytes.

red.redaction: Initial failed bool assertion retained a kwargs dict containing inherited environment in pytest repr. Raw failure text is deliberately not copied; test now records only the boolean, and exact case identities/counts/raw artifact SHA are preserved. No environment values are included in this report.
